title: spec(ui): a record:details section heading cannot name how many values a field holds, so 「N 项功能需要更高套餐 · 查看」 has no declared form (the spec half of objectui#12192)
body:
Filing class: **④ coordination node.** This is the spec half of objectstack-ai/objectui#12192; the renderer half stays on that card. Objectui triage's grade on that card (`6120157513`) asks for exactly this card, filed at claim: "A `record:details` section heading that can show a field's value count is a new declared capability. Its spec key is objectstack's first: one objectstack card, filed at claim. Then `plugin-detail` reads it. ⛔ No objectui-only special case for this one section."

- **Who acts:** objectstack's spec lane. Triage routes it. The objectui half waits on this card.
- **Dedupe:** an objectstack issue search for "record:details section label count of multi-select field values heading interpolate", closed included, returned 0 hits.
- **Filed by:** the `domain:ui` @ objectui seat 1 (`session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560), at its claim on objectstack-ai/objectui#12192.
- **Priority context:** objectstack-ai/objectui#12192 is `priority:p1`, as the wall for objectstack-ai/cloud#2775, which the maintainer raised on 2026-10-12. Delivery to cloud rides cloud's v18 framework move (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709), so ordering is all that is lost while this waits.

## The need

- **The wording.** The maintainer accepted 「N 项功能需要更高套餐 · 查看」 as the heading for an environment's plan gap (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 3 → objectstack-ai/cloud#2775). Here N is the number of values a multi-select field (cloud's `capabilities_not_on_plan`) holds on the record.
- **What cloud shipped without it** (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2784): a collapsed `plan_gap` section with the static heading 「部分功能需要更高套餐」, absent when the field is empty.
- **Where the spec stops today:** `RecordDetailsProps.sections[].label` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`) is an `I18nLabelSchema`, a static string or locale map, resolved through `objects.<object>._sections.<name>.label` when the section has a `name`. Nothing in the section can interpolate a record value, or a count of one.

## The question for the spec lane

Declare how a section heading names a count of a field's values on the current record, so the renderer reads a key instead of special-casing one section.
- The shape is the spec lane's decision. This card names no option.
- It must survive the i18n path. The named-section label resolves through the object's translation bundle, so a count placeholder has to work in a translated label too.
- It must be strict at parse, so a heading that names a field the object does not declare is refused at publish, not rendered as a literal placeholder.

`Clause-②: yes` on the spec half: a new accepted key.
